verdict.rationale: LM Studio ships llmster, a headless daemon that its docs describe as suited to servers, cloud instances and CI. It also offers a scriptable `lms` CLI (server start/stop, load, get), a REST API, and on-demand model loading for automated requests. A community user praises the headless flow as usable from real tools. An earlier complaint about having no pure daemon mode predates llmster and doesn't contradict it. Missing for 10: documented CI pipeline recipes or install/automation walkthroughs, broader independent hands-on corroboration of headless CI use.
